measurement_limits: A complete evidence record is not automatic legal approval, DNS validation or uptime proof. All launch confirmations remain null.
Application aggregates exclude visitor identifiers; hosts/CDNs/proxies/network services still receive connection metadata.
Origin can be forged; raw counters are incomplete, repeatable and potentially inflated. They are not people, eligible Amazon sessions or conversions.
Local fixtures use temporary counts, no Amazon navigation and no campaign-ledger writes. Node VM/local HTTP tests are not deployed browser CORS acceptance.
Reference http.server is not production hosting. One process per count file; standalone pruning requires a stopped collector. Retention and infrastructure logging require separate reviewed evidence.

official_source_reads.scope: Usage limits, not a determination by GitHub about this particular site.
Static hosting and Pages security IP logging.
Transport referrer policy; the client never reads document.referrer.
Best-effort analytics delivery across page unload.
Production warning; no assertion that the reference collector is production ready.
Disclosure and legal/privacy duties; no enrollment or hosting-use conclusion.
Special Links, privacy disclosures and prohibitions on artificial affiliate activity/related-person purchases; not account reporting evidence.
